rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was caused by duplicate detection evaluating an arbitrary same-hash finance_imports document, allowing an old silent-zero record to mask a newer useful import. The current fix filters for useful same-hash records directly by status and applied counters, which matches the user-visible contract: re-upload is allowed only when previous imports for that file hash applied no clients/documents, and blocked once any useful import exists.
